1.explanation:
• UIShell/README.md gives the overall API and behavioral contract for the rails variation of the shell.  
• SideNav.js is the top‐level component orchestrating the expanded/collapsed state of the rail and its child menus. It wires up the toggle button.  
• SideNavRail.js contains the specific rendering logic for the collapsed‐rail view and must coordinate hide/show of nested menus when collapsed.  
• SideNavMenu.js is responsible for opening/closing submenus and must respond to parent collapse events.  
• SideNavMenuItem.js handles individual submenu‐item rendering, focus, and active states (relevant to the ghost active state seen in the screenshot).  
• SideNav.test.js (or equivalent) contains the existing test assertions around rail collapse and keyboard navigation. Reviewing/updating these tests will help reproduce and verify fixes for collapsing submenus on rail collapse.
1.bug_scenario: In the collapsed-rail variation of the UI Shell SideNav, when you close (“rail‐collapse”) the shell while a submenu is still expanded, the submenu items remain open off–screen, creating empty whitespace in the collapsed rail (you can even see the focus/active state of a hidden submenu item). Keyboard navigation similarly expands the rail on submenu‐item focus but never collapses the submenu when the rail is closed. Visually this shows ghost rows of blank circles (the submenu icons) and misaligned active/focus styling.
